Describe the app entry or editorial correction and why it's useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] App entries follow the primary-category-only rule.
- [ ] Categories and app entries are sorted A–Z.
- [ ] Descriptions are original, factual, and roughly 100–180 characters.
- [ ] Each app's official website link is correct; any optional Cool Mac Apps **Read more** link is valid.
- [ ] README table of contents is up to date, if category headings changed.
- [ ] No app icons, screenshots, pricing badges, or unsupported claims were added.
- [ ] Changes comply with [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
